description: This header file declares functions, macros, and types related to establishing and managing network connections, as part of a larger codebase likely dealing with Git protocols.

methods.name: git_connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection based on input parameters such as file descriptors, URL, and flags.

methods.name: finish_connect
methods.description: Completes the connection process initiated by git_connect.

methods.name: git_connection_is_socket
methods.description: Determines if the connection is a socket.

methods.name: server_supports
methods.description: Checks if the server supports a specific feature.

methods.name: parse_feature_request
methods.description: Parses a feature request string to identify if a particular feature is requested.

methods.name: server_feature_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific server feature.

methods.name: url_is_local_not_ssh
methods.description: Determines whether a URL points to a local resource, excluding SSH URLs.

methods.name: discover_version
methods.description: Discovers the protocol version supported by the server.

methods.name: server_supports_hash
methods.description: Checks if the server supports a specific hash algorithm.

methods.name: parse_feature_value
methods.description: Parses the value associated with a feature.

methods.name: server_supports_v2
methods.description: Checks if the server supports protocol version 2.

methods.name: ensure_server_supports_v2
methods.description: Ensures that the server supports protocol version 2, potentially raising an error otherwise.

methods.name: server_feature_v2
methods.description: Retrieves the version 2 specific feature value from the server.

methods.name: server_supports_feature
methods.description: Checks if the server supports a specific feature, with optional error handling.

methods.name: check_stateless_delimiter
methods.description: Checks the delimiting condition for stateless RPC communication.
